name: FunASR SenseVoiceSmall Offline
author: OmniDesk
description: Local Vulkan/CPU FunASR SenseVoiceSmall chunked offline speech recognition with checkpoint resume (speech.asr.v1).

config_schema.label: FunASR 可执行文件路径
config_schema.description: Executable name on PATH or absolute path to llama-funasr-sensevoice

config_schema.label: SenseVoice 模型目录
config_schema.description: User-configured directory containing SenseVoice GGUF model files (no hardcoded path)

config_schema.label: 推理后端设备
config_schema.description: Inference backend device passed to llama-funasr-sensevoice (--backend)

config_schema.label: FFmpeg 路径
config_schema.description: Executable name on PATH or absolute path to ffmpeg

config_schema.label: FFprobe 路径
config_schema.description: Executable name on PATH or absolute path to ffprobe

config_schema.label: 分块切片时长（秒）
config_schema.description: Chunk duration in seconds for checkpointed offline transcription (default 300)

config_schema.label: 字幕输出根目录（可选）
config_schema.description: Optional confinement root directory for output SRT files; defaults to media directory

config_schema.label: 最大并发任务数
config_schema.description: Maximum number of concurrent ASR transcription jobs (1-16)
